title: Crafting Catalog Document Misc
description: The root object for defining the crafting catalog

categories.title: Categories
categories.description:
The categories we are adding groups to.

Properties:
• category_name (string)
• groups (object)

defaultSnippets.label: Crafting Catalog Category Misc
defaultSnippets.description: Represents a collection of groups of items in a category..

misc_crafting_catalog_group_icon.title: Crafting Catalog Group Icon Misc
misc_crafting_catalog_group_icon.description: The identifier of a group of items.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: The item or block that represents the group.

name.title: Name
name.description: A localization key representing the name of the group that starts with a namespace. The 'minecraft' namespace is reservered for the Vanilla game. Creating new group names starting with 'minecraft' run the risk of being overwritten in later updates.

misc_crafting_catalog_group.title: Crafting Catalog Group Misc
misc_crafting_catalog_group.description: Represents a group of items. A group can be collapsible if it is provided with a group identifier, or added a set of loose items without an icon.

group_identifier.title: Group Identifier
group_identifier.description:
Optional field to give an icon and name to a group. Otherwise the items are added as loose items.

Properties:
• icon (object)
• name (string)

defaultSnippets.label: Crafting Catalog Group Icon Misc
defaultSnippets.description: The identifier of a group of items.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of an item or block. A namespace for the item is required. You can optionally provide an aux value for items that use it at the end. Example: namespace:my_item:1

items.title: Items
items.description: The items to add to the group.

misc_crafting_catalog_category.title: Crafting Catalog Category Misc
misc_crafting_catalog_category.description: Represents a collection of groups of items in a category..

category_name.title: CraftingCatalogItemCategory
category_name.description: The category that the items will go to. This is restricted to construction, nature, equipment, or items.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description:
The groups that we are adding to a category.

Properties:
• group_identifier (object)
• items

defaultSnippets.label: Crafting Catalog Group Misc
defaultSnippets.description: Represents a group of items. A group can be collapsible if it is provided with a group identifier, or added a set of loose items without an icon.
